breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The original prompt incorrectly specified both Dirichlet and Periodic boundary conditions, which are incompatible for this problem. The ground truth removed the periodic condition. The agent correctly identified this conflict and generated a specification that only includes the Dirichlet boundary condition, thus resolving the inconsistency.
